cases.source_branch: Mounted intended U-turn governed by a no-U-turn sign

activation_conditions_to_verify: authorized no-U-turn sign governs mounted bicycle approach
rider remains mounted and makes or avoids U-turn

channels.name: dev.regulatory_sign

channels.uncertainty: 50 ms sampling; original sign and rider pixels require review

channels.method: Original Native body and heading trace; requested turn is separate

channels.uncertainty: 50 ms sampling; original sign and rider pixels require review

channels.uncertainty: 50 ms sampling; original sign and rider pixels require review

channels.name: camera_frame_join
channels.reference_frame: Native map and original camera frame
channels.uncertainty: 50 ms sampling; original sign and rider pixels require review

context_inputs.method: Native lane/landmark readback and original sign pixel review
context_inputs.name: signed_hill_crest

limitations: Authored sign is not proof of legal authorization
Bicycle blueprint does not prove mounted rider posture
Requested turn does not prove physical movement or a legal outcome
